description: He wears a burgundy-purple patterned long tunic over a cream undertunic with long sleeves and a visible lower hem. Gold woven borders run vertically down the tunic and around the sleeve ends and hem. A dark burgundy mantle with gold borders hangs from his anatomical left shoulder and is fastened by a round red-centered gold clasp. A brown leather belt with matching decorative fittings wraps the waist. Dark trousers and tall dark brown boots with ornate gold straps are visible below. Cloth appears heavy and textured with a restrained sheen; exact fiber is uncertain.
